name: Zipz Grilled Chicken Sandwich, Philly Cheesesteak, or All-Beef Hot Dog
whyItWorks: Zipz offers grilled chicken breast sandwiches, shaved beef cheesesteaks, and all-beef hot dogs on white buns with a DIY sauce bar so you control every condiment.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Grilled Chicken Sandwich (not chipotle/spicy), Philly Cheesesteak without bell peppers/onions, or a plain Hot Dog.
watchOuts: Order Philly Cheesesteak without sautéed bell peppers and onions
Skip spicy sauces at the dipping bar
